tenderSchedule.locationName: ELCITA Chief Executive Officer Office Bengaluru

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Experience in E-Toilet / Prefabricated Toilet Projects: Experience in supplying, installing, and commissioning E-Toilets, prefabricated public toilets, or automated sanitation units. Evaluation based on track record, complexity of past installations, bio-digester integration, automation systems handled, awards, and past client certifications.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Presentation to be given by the bidder at the time of evaluation.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Technical Capabilities Vendors expertise in E-Toilet fabrication using SS 304, integration of automation systems (sensors, auto flush, floor wash, voice guidance), IoT readiness, availability of skilled personnel, and essential equipment for fabrication, installation, anchoring, plumbing, and electrical works as per design & BOQ.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Presentation to be given by the bidder at the time of evaluation.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Quality of Work Assessment of past executed works based on material durability, fabrication quality, welding finish, anti-skid flooring standards, sanitation system performance, waterproofing quality, and adherence to technical specifications. Sample photos, factory QC documentation, and material test reports will be examined.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Presentation to be given by the bidder at the time of evaluation.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Project Management Capabilities Ability to deliver the project within timelines, manage logistics, coordinate civil utility connections (water, power, drainage), and ensure smooth on-site installation. Vendor must assign a dedicated Project Manager and a Site Engineer/Technician for execution.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Presentation to be given by the bidder at the time of evaluation.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: References from Past Clients Feedback from previous clients for similar installations, performance certificates, O&M satisfaction, uptime of automated features, and maintenance responsiveness.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Presentation to be given by the bidder at the time of evaluation.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Financial Stability Assessment of the vendors financial ability to execute the project, including IT returns or audited financial statements for the last three years to verify turnover, liquidity, and overall stability.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Presentation to be given by the bidder at the time of evaluation.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Innovation and Creativity Vendors ability to offer enhanced features such as solar integration, water-saving technology, remote IoT monitoring dashboard, vandal-proof design, energy-efficient systems, or improved accessibility features for differently-abled users.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Presentation to be given by the bidder at the time of evaluation.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Local Presence Vendor must have a local service office for better coordination and faster response during installation and AMC. Proof such as GST registration, utility bill, or government-issued address document is required.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Presentation to be given by the bidder at the time of evaluation.
